scene: Steam bursts from the brass pipe, opening three exit gates simultaneously.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a tiled pavilion floor. The elderly man in his blue cap and orange cardigan stands holding his cane, watching steam hiss from an overhead pipe. On the left waits a glass funicular car; in the centre sits a red-hooded rickshaw with driver; on the far right waits a hand-cranked trolley.
shown: a steep glass funicular car waiting at its track gate on the left
a red-hooded rickshaw with a smiling driver parked in the centre
a brass hand-cranked trolley resting on gleaming rails on the far right
